programme.title: The Age of Uncertainty
programme.desc: JK Galbraith looks at the influence of John Maynard Keynes, who drew the blueprint for the postwar economic boom, and recalls his own involvement in those momentous years.

programme.title: The Age of Uncertainty
programme.desc: JK Galbraith visits the ruins of postwar Berlin, the corridors of power in the Pentagon and 'the world's largest used plane lot' in his assessment of the contemporary roots of war.

programme.title: Dance Passion
programme.desc: In a dynamic fusion of movement, colour and energy, dancers of all kinds take over the streets, theatres and surrounding countryside to showcase the city and celebrate the joy of dance, during Bradford 2025 UK City of Culture.

programme.title: Fred Dibnah's Age of Steam
programme.desc: Fred explores the extraordinary role of steam in the expansion of industrial Britain. Along the way, Fred learns how huge stationary steam engines continued to be used in mills, collieries and steel works until well into the 20th century.

programme.title: Pubs, Ponds, and Power: The Story of the Village
programme.desc: Ben Robinson explores London, the ultimate `city of villages'. Despite many rural settlements like Hornsey and Dagenham being swallowed up by the expanding capital, Hampstead residents successfully fought to preserve their village heritage.

programme.title: Earth's Seasonal Secrets
programme.desc: We celebrate the glorious nature of Summer on planet Earth, and the extraordinary ways animals and plants rise to the challenges it brings. With the sun shining and the flowers blooming, this is the season of splendid abundance, and the long hours of daylight make life burst out in a riot of activity. But you have to find clever ways to get your share of the good times while they last and as temperatures soar, everything has to deal with sweltering heat.

programme.title: Dan Cruickshank's Monuments of Remembrance
programme.desc: Dan Cruickshank reveals the extraordinary story behind the design and building of the iconic World War One cemeteries and memorials, including those at the Somme and Gallipoli, and of the remarkable man whose vision created them.

programme.title: Call My Bluff
programme.desc: Robert Robinson referees as Frank Muir, André Previn and Tina Brown compete against Patrick Campbell, Tom Conti and Barbara Kellerman in a duel of words and wit.

programme.title: Face the Music

programme.title: The Sky at Night
programme.sub-title: Space Mysteries: The Sky at Night Meets Curious Cases
programme.desc: Do aliens exist, and can we talk to them? What does a black hole sound like? Does the universe look like a doughnut? In a spectacular season finale, `The Sky at Night' teams up with hit podcast `Curious Cases' to answer your burning space mysteries.

programme.title: Arena
programme.sub-title: Sister Wendy and the Art of the Gospel
programme.desc: Searching of the `real' Sister Wendy Beckett, who burst on to screens in the 1990s, telling the story of Christian art and painting, but revealing little of her own extraordinary story. Wendy herself, 82, talks frankly, humorously and profoundly about her life and spirituality for the first time. Her story, inseparable from that of the Gospel, is told alongside her selection of paintings by the greatest old masters.

programme.title: Inside Museums
programme.desc: Manchester-born Diana Ali returns to The Whitworth, which had a profound impact on her life and inspired her career as an artist, to explore how art can speak a universal language, stir emotions and challenge beliefs. The Whitworth Art Gallery is a clash of past and present with a collection from around the world. The city's industrial history has shaped what's within the gallery walls to provide an insight into our shared heritage.

programme.title: Railway Walks
programme.desc: Julia Bradbury takes a series of walks following the old tracks, overgrown cuttings and ancient viaducts of Britain's lost rail empire. She begins her exploration of Britain's lost rail empire in Derbyshire, the heart of the Peak District, with a walk along the popular Monsal Trail. Limestone cliffs and gorges abound, not to mention the tunnels and soaring viaducts of the dramatic and unlikely Midland Railway.

programme.title: The Many Faces of...
programme.desc: June Whitfield worked alongside the greats Arthur Askey, Tony Hancock, Frankie Howerd, Ronnie Barker, Benny Hill, Bob Monkhouse, Terry Scott and Jennifer Saunders. In this film June tells her own story, from her early days in the West End working with Noel Coward, her ill-fated Broadway debut, and with the help of rarely seen archive, impeccable comedy performances on radio and TV.

programme.title: Happy Ever After
programme.desc: Pilot programme of the classic sitcom Happy Ever After, made in 1974 as part of the Comedy Playhouse series and starring Terry Scott and June Whitfield as a couple adjusting to life alone after their children have flown the nest. Five series of Happy Ever After followed.

programme.title: Beggar My Neighbour: Have Car: Won't Travel
programme.desc: Reg Varney introduces an episode of the 1960s BBC sitcom Beggar My Neighbour, starring Peter Jones, June Whitfield, Reg Varney and Pat Coombs.
‫Two British soldiers must cross enemy territory and deliver a timely message to stop a deadly attack.‬

programme.title: Imagine...
programme.desc: Revealing the darker side of one of Britain's most original and inventive artists. A sculptor working with found materials, Cornelia Parker creates beauty from acts of brutality: an exploded shed, piles of squashed silver, the charred remnants of a burnt church suspended in time.

programme.title: Inside Museums
programme.desc: Kelvingrove Art Gallery and Museum is a place artist Lachlan Goudie has loved since he was a boy. He explores Glasgow's most popular cultural jewel, home to thousands of treasures.

programme.title: Railway Walks
programme.desc: Julia walks along the stunning Mawddach estuary in north Wales. The area between Dolgellau and the coastal resort of Barmouth is one of the least visited parts of Snowdonia, but in the 1860s it received a great rush of holidaymakers, taking advantage of the new railway that connected the valley to the cities of England.

programme.title: The Secret Life of the Sun
programme.desc: Ninety million miles away from us is the power that shapes our world - the Sun. Using the latest satellite images, and the expertise of Britain's leading solar scientists, Kate Humble and Helen Czerski reveal the inner workings of our very own star, and the influence its mysterious cycles of activity have on our planet.

programme.title: Hunt for the Oldest DNA
programme.desc: Follows the scientists deciphering the oldest DNA ever found, and reveals for the first time the genes of long-extinct creatures that once thrived in warm, lush Arctic landscapes.

programme.title: Graham Reid Remembers... The Precious Blood
programme.desc: Writer Graham Reid looks back on his 1996 BBC drama The Precious Blood. Set in a Belfast trying to secure a lasting peace, The Precious Blood conveys conflicts both practically and emotionally. Billy was a UVF killer but has turned his former political fervour into a newfound religious faith. Rosie is the widow of a man shot at the height of the troubles. Graham Reid explains how he brought the two stories together - Billy, tormented by his past, trying to find a path to his own atonement.

programme.title: Screen Two
programme.desc: Rosie Williams is haunted by the murder of her husband, and her teenage son John is heading for a life of delinquency fuelled by revenge. Then, he meets Billy McVea, who runs a boxing gym, affecting all their lives.

programme.title: Graham Reid Remembers... Life After Life
programme.desc: Writer Graham Reid, known for the Billy Plays - a trilogy that starred a young Kenneth Branagh, looks back on his 1995 TV drama Life After Life, a powerful addition to his work on the Troubles. The film looks at how the ceasefires of the mid-1990s brought their own problems. It focuses on Leo, a murderer released from prison expecting a hero's return. Instead, he is greeted by a city that thinks he's irrelevant.

programme.title: Screen Two
programme.desc: Leo Doyle, in his mid-30s and single, is released into ceasefire Belfast after serving a life sentence for an IRA murder. Desperate for a new cause, he tries to rekindle an affair with his ex-fiancee.

programme.desc: Bringing the best in television.

programme.title: Y Tralalas
programme.desc: Mae Harmoni, Melodi a Bop yn y farchnad lle ma na lot o stondinau yn gwerthu lot o nwyddau. Harmoni, Melodi and Bop are in the market where there are lots of stalls selling different things.

programme.title: Twt
programme.desc: Mae golau Lewis y Goleudy yn chwythu. All cychod yr harbwr gydweithio i dywys Pop 'nôl i'r harbwr yn saff? Lewis the Lighthouse is an important part of the harbour community. The boats and ships rely on him to guide them into the harbour safely.

programme.title: Jambori
programme.desc: Hello and welcome to Jamborî! Come and join Jam on a musical adventure full of interesting sounds and colourful pictures where shadows dance, robots play and fruits move to the music.

programme.title: Pentre Papur Pop
programme.desc: Ar antur popwych heddiw ma hi'n ben-blwydd ar Twm. Ond pan ma Twm yn gofyn gormod, fydd y ffrindiau'n gallu rhoi diwrnod i'w gofio iddo. On today's poptastic adventure, it's Twm's birthday.

programme.title: Cacamwnci
programme.desc: Cyfres gomedi i blant meithrin sy'n cynnwys sgetsys, eitemau doniol, jôcs a chymeriadau dwl iawn. A comedy show for pre-school children, full of sketches, jokes, fun, monkey nonsense and great new comedy characters.

programme.title: Yr Whws
programme.desc: Wrth chwilio am drysor môr-ladron, mae Wini yn darganfod wy bychan ar y traeth. As the Woohoos search for pirate treasure, Wynona finds a little egg on the beach.

programme.title: Anifeiliaid Bach y Byd
programme.desc: Dewch ar antur gyda ni i gwrdd ag anifeiliaid bach y byd. Yn y rhaglen hon y panda a'r macaw sy'n cael y sylw. Revolving around getting to know the animals the panda and the macaw.

programme.title: Dreigiau Cadi
programme.desc: Yn yr iard ym Mhendre, mae Cadi'n sylweddoli ei bod wedi colli bollt bwysig. Mae angen ei ffeindio! In the Pendre yard, Cadi realises that she has lost an important bolt. She must find it!

programme.title: Sam Tân
programme.desc: Mae Dilys ar ras yn ceisio cael Norman i'r Ganolfan Weithgareddau Mynydd er mwyn hedfan yn Walabi 2. Dilys rushes to get Norman to the Mountain Activities Centre in time to fly in Walabi 2.

programme.title: Parc Glan Gwil
programme.desc: Mae Syr Gwil yn trefnu parti pwll nofio, ond mae Dion Diogelwch yn ofnus - 'dio ddim yn medru nofio. Syr Gwil organises a swimming pool party, but Dion Diogelwch is scared as he can't swim.

programme.title: Cywion Bach
programme.desc: Mae'r Cywion Bach wrth eu bodd yn gweld enfys ac yn hapus mai 'enfys' yw gair arbennig heddiw. Dere i ddysgu ac arwyddo'r gair gyda nhw! The Cywion are excited to see a rainbow in the sky!

programme.title: Guto Gwningen
programme.desc: Pan mae Guto Gwningen yn clywed am ladrad ei dad,mae'n Cynllunio i ddwyn tatws Mr Puw! When Guto Gwningen hears about his father's greatest heist, he embarks on his own, Mr Puw's potatoes!

programme.title: Awyr Iach
programme.desc: Mae Meleri yn cwrdd a theulu sy'n mwynhau Geocashio, ac mae Jeno a'i theulu yn ymweld a Bwlch Nant yr Arian. Today, Huw joins a group of children keeping the village of Llanberis tidy.

programme.title: Pablo
programme.desc: Mae gan Pablo ei ffordd ei hun o weld y byd. Heddiw mae'r niwl yn gwneud i bopeth edrych yn llwyd. Sut all Pablo a'r criw ddod a lliw yn ol i'w byd? The fog is making everything look grey, so Pablo needs to colour the fog!

programme.title: Help Llaw
programme.desc: Mae Harri'n cael galwad gan Osian a Cochyn o Barc y Scarlets i ddweud fod y gawod yn yr ystafell newid wedi torri. Harri gets a call from Parc y Scarlets to say that the shower is broken.

programme.title: Y Pitws Bychain
programme.desc: Mae'r Pitws Bychain yn cael picnic! Maen nhw'n llawn cyffro wrth ddadbacio eu bwyd o'r fasged. Ond arhoswch, i ble aeth y bwyd. The Wee Littles are having a picnic, but the food disappears.

programme.title: Patrôl Pawennau
programme.sub-title: Cŵn yn Achub Cantorion y Coed
programme.desc: Pan mae Cantorion Coed Porth yr haul yn diflannu, mae'n rhaid i'r Pawenlu ddod a'u cân yn ôl. Egg nests are found with the mother songbirds missing, so Ryder and Chase begin searching for the mother birds.

programme.title: Odo
programme.desc: Cartwn hyfryd am gwdihw bach o'r enw Odo a'i ffrindiau yn y goedwig. A little owl called Odo and his woodland friends aim to combat the rise of anxiety in pre-school children by teaching them self-efficacy and to believe in themselves.

programme.title: Joni Jet
programme.desc: Ma Jetboi a Jetferch yn anghytuno, ond pan fydd Lili Lafant yn hypnoteiddio dinasyddion i'w ufuddhau hi ma'r gwahaniaethau'n troi'n gryfder. Lily Lafant hypnotises citizens into obeying her.

programme.title: Deian a Loli
programme.desc: Tydi Deian ddim yn hoffi ysbytai, felly pan mae'n disgyn a brifo ei fraich does dim dewis ond rhewi dad cyn iddo gael ei orfodi i fynd! Deian doesn't like hospitals, so when he hurts his arm he freezes dad before he's forced to go.

programme.title: Y Tralalas
programme.desc: Mae'r Tralalas yn mynd ar daith i'r dref: dewch gyda nhw. Mae cymaint i'w weld yn y dref, ac hefyd yn yr awyr. The Tralalas take a tour of the city and there is so much to see in the city and also in the air.
